name: Basil
hook: Stop buying basil. Grow a bushy plant on your windowsill.

steps.title: Full sun or grow light
steps.tip: Give it your brightest window or a sunny balcony; leggy stems mean it needs more light.

steps.title: Keep soil just moist
steps.tip: Keep soil evenly moist; water the soil, not the leaves, ideally in the morning.

steps.title: Pinch above leaf pairs
steps.tip: Snip stems just above a leaf pair; new shoots sprout there and the plant gets bushier.

steps.title: Remove flower buds
steps.tip: Pinch off flower spikes as soon as they appear to keep leaves sweet and coming.

steps.title: Warm and cozy
steps.tip: Basil blackens in the cold; keep it indoors once nights fall below 10°C.

steps.title: Root cuttings in water
steps.tip: Root non-flowering 10 cm shoots in water, lower leaves off; pot up in a few weeks.

outro: Pinch often, pick often. The more you harvest, the more you get.
